command:
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
s=collections.Counter(); n=collections.Counter(); mx=0
for l in open('/var/log/kubernetes/audit.log'):
 try: e=json.loads(l)
 except: continue
 k=(e.get('verb'),e.get('objectRef',{}).get('resource'),e.get('level')); s[str(k)]+=len(l);n[str(k)]+=1;mx=max(mx,len(l))
print('largest_record_bytes',mx); print('bytes_by_operation',s.most_common(12));print('counts',n.most_common(8))
PY
sudo helm show values oci://ghcr.io/k0rdent/kof/charts/kof-collectors --version 1.6.0 | head -100

# values pulled from defaults from https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-helm-charts/blob/main/charts/opentelemetry-kube-stack/values.yaml
# and modified to actually reflect kof-specific collection of k0rdent-based installation metrics, and logs, and whatnot

global:
  # custom image registry for kube-state-metrics and prometheus-node-exporter charts
  imageRegistry: ""
  clusterLabel: cluster
  clusterName: mothership
  clusterNamespace: kcm-system
kof:
  basic_auth: true
  instrumentation:
    enabled: true
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 512Mi
      limits:
        memory: 512Mi
kcm:
  # -- Enable kcm manager and other components monitoring
  monitoring: false
  # -- K8s namespace created on installation of k0rdent/kcm.
  namespace: kcm-system
  serviceMonitor:
    # -- Selector of `kcm-controller-manager-metrics-monitor`
    selector:
      matchLabels:
        control-plane: kcm-controller-manager
opentelemetry-kube-stack:
  cleanupJob:
    enabled: false
    existingServiceAccount: ""
    image:
      digest: ""
      repository: bitnamilegacy/kubectl
      tag: 1.32
  clusterName: ""
  clusterRole:
    annotations: {}
    enabled: true
    rules: []
  collectors:
    cluster:
      config:
        processors:
          batch:
            send_batch_max_size: 1500
            send_batch_size: 1000
            timeout: 1s
          transform/events:
            error_mode: ignore
            log_statements:
              - context: log
                conditions:
                  - IsMatch(attributes["k8s.resource.name"], "events")
                statements:
                  - delete_key(body["object"]["metadata"], "managedFields") where IsMap(body)
                  - delete_key(body["object"], "eventTime") where IsMap(body)
                  - flatten(body["object"], prefix="event", resolveConflicts=true) where IsMap(body)
                  - merge_maps(attributes, body["object"], "upsert") where IsMap(body)
          transform/k8scluster:
            metric_statements:
              - context: scope
                conditions:
                  - IsMatch(scope.name, "k8scluster")
                statements:
                  - set(resource.attributes["service.name"], "k8scluster")
                  - set(resource.attributes["service.instance.id"], resource.attributes["k8s.pod.uid"])
              - context: resource
                conditions:
                  - resource.attributes["service.instance.id"] == nil
                statements:
                  - set(resource.attributes["service.instance.id"], resource.attributes["k8s.node.uid"])
              - context: datapoint
                statements:
                  - set(datapoint.cache["attrs"], resource.attributes)
                  - keep_matching_keys(datapoint.cache["attrs"], "k8s.*")
                  - merge_maps(datapoint.attributes, datapoint.cache["attrs"], "insert")
          resourcedetection:
            detectors:
              - env
              - kubeadm
            override: false
            timeout: 2s
        receivers:
          k8sobjects:
            auth_type: serviceAccount
            objects:
              - name: events
                mode: watch
                group: events.k8s.io
                exclude_watch_type:
                  - DELETED
        service:
          pipelines:
            traces:
              receivers:
                - nop
              exporters:
                - nop
